# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 4 Slot 81: Eurasian Economy 2.0 — O(1) 12-Hub Grain/Silver/Credit Network (oe_econ2_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_eurasia_econ2.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Slot 81 Monthly Entry Point (Quarterly Staggered O(1) Eurasian Economy 2.0)
# ==============================================================================

# Any country scope (BYZ mainline scheduler Slot 81 or fallback pulse).
oe_econ2_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_econ2_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west value = 30 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_east value = 30 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_index value = 60 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_grain_black_sea value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_grain_nile value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_grain_caoyun value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_silver_tide value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_clearing_tier value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { current_month = 1 }
		oe_econ2_eval_grain_corridors = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { current_month = 4 }
		oe_econ2_eval_west_hubs = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { current_month = 7 }
		oe_econ2_eval_east_hubs = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { current_month = 10 }
		oe_econ2_eval_silver_credit = yes
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Q1 (January): 3 Intercontinental Grain Corridors (9 Fixed Locations, O(1))
# ==============================================================================

oe_econ2_eval_grain_corridors = {
	# 1. Black Sea - Aegean Annona Corridor (kaffa/tana/cetatea_alba -> constantinople)
	if = {
		limit = {
			location:constantinople = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			OR = {
				location:kaffa = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
				location:tana = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
				location:cetatea_alba = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_grain_black_sea value = 1 }
		location:constantinople = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes }
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
						add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_econ2_black_sea_grain_flow years = 2 mode = replace }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_grain_black_sea value = 0 }
		location:constantinople = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes }
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							is_rebel_country = no
							is_ai = no
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_bs_crisis_cd }
						}
						set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_bs_crisis_cd years = 10 }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.2
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# 2. Nile Valley Shuna Granary Corridor (cairo + alexandria + damietta)
	if = {
		limit = {
			location:cairo = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			OR = {
				location:alexandria = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
				location:damietta = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_grain_nile value = 1 }
		location:cairo = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes }
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
						add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_econ2_nile_grain_surplus years = 2 mode = replace }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_grain_nile value = 0 }
		location:cairo = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes }
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							is_rebel_country = no
							is_ai = no
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_nile_crisis_cd }
						}
						set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_nile_crisis_cd years = 10 }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.3
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# 3. Grand Canal & Sea Tribute Caoyun Corridor (hangzhou/suzhou/shangyuan -> dadu; Yuan/Ming/Qing compatible)
	if = {
		limit = {
			location:dadu = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			OR = {
				location:hangzhou = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
				location:suzhou = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
				location:shangyuan = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_grain_caoyun value = 1 }
		location:dadu = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes }
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
						add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_econ2_caoyun_grain_flow years = 2 mode = replace }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_grain_caoyun value = 0 }
		location:dadu = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes }
				owner = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							is_rebel_country = no
							is_ai = no
							NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_caoyun_crisis_cd }
						}
						set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_caoyun_crisis_cd years = 10 }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.4
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Q2 (April): Western Eurasian 6-Hub Prosperity Evaluation (O(1))
# ==============================================================================

oe_econ2_eval_west_hubs = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west value = 0 }
	location:constantinople = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 6 }
			if = {
				limit = { prosperity >= 0.25 }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:venice = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 6 }
			if = {
				limit = { prosperity >= 0.25 }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:genoa = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 6 }
			if = {
				limit = { prosperity >= 0.25 }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:alexandria = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 6 }
			if = {
				limit = { prosperity >= 0.25 }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:kaffa = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 6 }
			if = {
				limit = { prosperity >= 0.25 }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:gdansk = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_econ2_node_healthy = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 6 }
			if = {
				limit = { prosperity >= 0.25 }
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_west add = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	oe_econ2_recompute_hub_index = yes
	# Gdansk Baltic Grain Bills milestone for human holder
	location:gdansk = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						is_rebel_country = no
						current_year >= 1450
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_ev11_done }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_ev11_done value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.11
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	oe_econ2_recompute_hub_index = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_econ2_hub_index

	else_if = {
		limit = {

		}
	}
}

oe_econ2_recompute_hub_index = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_index value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_econ2_hub_west }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_index add = global_var:oe_econ2_hub_west }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_econ2_hub_east }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_hub_index add = global_var:oe_econ2_hub_east }
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Q4 (October): Silver Tide, 5 Monetary Pillars & v9.7/v12.5 Bridge (O(1))
# ==============================================================================

oe_econ2_inject_clearing_markets = {
	location:constantinople = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_econ2_silver_clearing_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:venice = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_econ2_silver_clearing_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:genoa = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_econ2_silver_clearing_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:guangzhou = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_econ2_porcelain_spice_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	location:maynila = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = market }
			market = {
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_econ2_porcelain_spice_demand years = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_econ2_eval_silver_credit = {
	# Advance Potosi (ccantumarcani) & Iwami (nima) Silver Tide index from 1545 or v12.5 global sentinel
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				current_year >= 1545
				has_global_variable = oe_cri2_silver_tide_active
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_silver_tide value = 45 }
		if = {
			limit = { location:ccantumarcani = { has_owner = yes } }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_silver_tide add = 25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { location:nima = { has_owner = yes } }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_silver_tide add = 20 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cri2_silver_tide_active }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_silver_tide add = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_econ2_silver_announced } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_silver_announced value = 1 }
			oe_econ2_inject_clearing_markets = yes
			location:constantinople = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes }
					owner = {
						if = {
							limit = { is_ai = no is_rebel_country = no }
							trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.7
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Piacenza & Genoa clearing milestone (1550+)
	location:genoa = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						is_rebel_country = no
						current_year >= 1550
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_ev8_done }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_ev8_done value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.8
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Golden Horn / Venice banking arbitrage bridge with v9.7 oe_eco_v97_*
	location:constantinople = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						is_rebel_country = no
						OR = {
							oe_eco_v97_has_bank_or_company = yes
							has_country_modifier = oe_eco_v97_bond_service
						}
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_ev9_done }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_ev9_done value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.9
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Jingdezhen / Guangzhou / Manila porcelain-spice bridge (1565+)
	location:guangzhou = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						is_rebel_country = no
						current_year >= 1565
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_ev10_done }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_ev10_done value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.10
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# East Asian Jiaochao / Single-Whip silver anchoring check
	location:dadu = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes }
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = no
						is_rebel_country = no
						current_year >= 1555
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_econ2_ev12_done }
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_ev12_done value = 1 }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.12
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dev Panel Page 79 Helper Effects (Stage wires directly to oe_dev.79)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Immediately recomputes all 3 grain corridors, 12 hubs, and opens oe_econ2.90 readout.
oe_econ2_dev_recalc_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_econ2_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_clearing_tier value = 1 }
	}
	oe_econ2_eval_grain_corridors = yes
	oe_econ2_eval_west_hubs = yes
	oe_econ2_eval_east_hubs = yes
	oe_econ2_eval_silver_credit = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.90
}

# Country scope. Simulates the 1545 Potosi-Iwami Silver Tide & fires oe_econ2.7 + oe_econ2.10.
oe_econ2_dev_trigger_silver_tide = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_init value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_silver_tide value = 85 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_econ2_silver_announced value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_cri2_silver_tide_active value = 1 }
	oe_econ2_inject_clearing_markets = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.7
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.10
}

# Country scope. Tests Ever-Normal Granary relief & corridor crisis synergy with v12.5 Little Ice Age.
oe_econ2_dev_granary_lia_test = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_econ2_has_ever_normal_granary value = 1 }
	remove_variable = oe_econ2_granary_relief_cd
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.2
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.6
}

# Country scope. Opens the live Eurasian Economy 2.0 audit readout (oe_econ2.90).
oe_econ2_dev_readout = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_econ2.90
}
